chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab narrated from Ghiyath ibn Kallub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad, from his father عليه السلام, that ‘Ali عليه السلام used to say:

The khuntha is given inheritance according to the place from which they urinate. If they urinate from both, then inheritance is assigned according to whichever of the two the urine precedes from. If they die without having urinated, then [there is] half the blood money of a man and half the blood money of a woman.

key_terms.الْبَوْلُ: Urination, used here as the legal criterion for classification.
key_terms.الْخُنْثَى: A person of indeterminate sex in legal classification.
key_terms.نِصْفُ عَقْلِ الرَّجُلِ: Half the blood money of a man.
key_terms.نِصْفُ عَقْلِ الْمَرْأَةِ: Half the blood money of a woman.
key_terms.يُوَرَّثُ: Is given inheritance or assigned an inheritance ruling.

ai.seo_question: How is the inheritance of a khuntha determined in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the inheritance status of a khuntha, determining classification by the organ from which urination occurs. If both are present, priority is given to whichever one urinates first, and if death occurs before that is known, the ruling assigns half the blood money of a man and half the blood money of a woman.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5701 - Al-Hasan ibn Musa Al-Khasshab narrated from Ghiyath ibn Kallub from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) used to say:

"The hermaphrodite is given inheritance based on the place from which they urinate. If they urinate from both, then inheritance is determined by whichever one the urine exits from first. If they die without urinating, then they are assigned half the blood money of a man and half the blood money of a woman."
